Definition: to flaunt, i.e. raise a flag; figuratively, to be conspicuous
BiblicalUsage: 1) to look, behold; 1a) (Qal) looked at, conspicuous (participle); 2) to carry a banner or standard, set up banner or standard; 2a)(Qal) to set up standard (in battle); 2b) (Niphal) supplied with banners, bannered
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
